facts.fact: A third-party claim cited by StackAdapt says people tend to overestimate how long they wait by 36%.
facts.quote: People tend to overestimate how long they wait by 36%

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's example, the in-banner video ad ran for 10 seconds, though it felt longer to viewers before a progress bar was added.
facts.quote: If you take out your stopwatch, you’ll find that the ad only ran for 10 seconds.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's example of a multi-step ad, the user makes a selection from 2 sets of prompts before being redirected to the landing page.
facts.quote: Telling the user that there are 2 steps before they can be redirected identifies how many clicks it will take to reach the landing page.
